name: anon-webrtc-call
description: Anonymous, fully client-side peer-to-peer WebRTC audio/video calling webapp

scripts.dev:https: bun run build && HTTPS=1 bun dev-server.js
scripts.certs: mkdir -p certs && mkcert -install && mkcert -cert-file certs/cert.pem -key-file certs/key.pem localhost 127.0.0.1 ::1
